title: Do Renewable Portfolio Standards Deliver Cost-Effective Carbon Abatement?
abstract: The United States’ most prevalent climate policies are Renewable Portfolio Standards (RPS) that mandate a specified share of electricity come from low-CO2 sources like wind and solar. Using a difference-in-differences style research design, we find that electricity prices are 11% higher seven years after RPS passage. Estimates also indicate that CO2 emissions are 8-17% lower seven years after passage, though they are sensitive to specification (unlike the price estimates). Together, the estimates suggest that the cost per abated CO2 ton ranges from $86-$211. Additionally, there is suggestive evidence that the cost per increment of mandated low-CO2 generation declined after 2010.
abstract_zh: 美国最普遍的气候政策是可再生能源配额制（Renewable Portfolio Standards，RPS），该政策强制规定电力中来自风能和太阳能等低二氧化碳排放来源的份额。采用双重差分式的研究设计，我们发现，RPS实施七年后，电价高出11%。估计结果还表明，RPS实施七年后，二氧化碳排放降低了8%至17%，但这些结果对模型设定较为敏感（与价格估计不同）。综合来看，这些估计表明，每减排一吨二氧化碳的成本在86美元至211美元之间。此外，有一定证据表明，2010年后，每增加一单位强制性低碳发电量的成本有所下降。

title: The Global Electrification Frontier and Climate Change
abstract: Off-grid solar promises a low-cost and carbon-free path to electrification. But will poor households choose off-grid power? We run a multi-year pricing experiment in rural India to estimate demand over all electricity sources, including off-grid solar, diesel generators and the grid. We find that off-grid solar is an important stop-gap, but households value grid electrification 6.6 times more. The grid, however, barely increases global surplus, because grid carbon damages nearly offset households’ gains. We apply our model to data from Africa and find a similarly strong preference for the grid among households there, underscoring the external validity of our results.
abstract_zh: 离网太阳能有望成为一条低成本、无碳的电气化路径。但贫困家庭会选择离网电力吗？我们在印度农村开展了一项为期数年的定价实验，以估计包括离网太阳能、柴油发电机和电网在内的所有电力来源的需求。我们发现，离网太阳能是一种重要的过渡性方案，但家庭对电网电气化的评价高出6.6倍。然而，电网几乎没有增加全球剩余，因为电网的碳排放损害几乎抵消了家庭的收益。我们将模型应用于非洲的数据，发现当地家庭同样强烈偏好电网，这凸显了我们结果的外部有效性。

title: The Local Damages from Global Climate Change
abstract: This paper produces the first estimates of local damages from climate change, reflecting heterogeneous exposure and responses to climate for ∼25,000 globally comprehensive regions. Global damages from a marginal ton of CO 2 emissions (i.e., the social cost of carbon) are $336 (2025 USD), with just 5% occurring in OECD countries that account for half of historical emissions. Restricting to country-level analysis obscures half the variation in local damages. Despite large benefits from adaptation and modest average impacts, 7% of world population experiences annually recurring Great Recession level damages by 2100 under business-as-usual warming. These findings illustrate climate change's marked inequality.
abstract_zh: 本文首次估算了气候变化造成的局部损害，考虑了约25,000个全球覆盖的地区因气候暴露和应对方式不同而产生的异质性。全球每排放一吨二氧化碳的边际损害（即碳的社会成本）为336美元（2025年美元价格），其中仅有5%发生在经合组织（OECD）国家，而这些国家承担了历史排放的一半。仅限于国家层面的分析掩盖了局部损害中一半的差异。尽管适应措施带来了可观的收益，且平均影响较为温和，但在一切照旧的变暖情景下，到2100年，全球7%的人口每年都将遭受相当于大衰退（Great Recession）水平的损害。这些发现揭示了气候变化显著的不平等性。

title: Can Pollution Markets Work in Developing Countries? Experimental Evidence from India
abstract: Market-based environmental regulations are seldom used in low-income countries, where pollution is highest but state capacity is often low. We collaborated with the Gujarat Pollution Control Board (GPCB) to design and experimentally evaluate the world’s first particulate-matter emissions market, which covered industrial plants in a large Indian city. There are three main findings. First, the market functioned well. Treatment plants, randomly assigned to the emissions market, traded permits to become significant net sellers or buyers. After trading, treatment plants held enough permits to cover their emissions 99% of the time, compared with just 66% compliance with standards under the command-and-control status quo. Second, treatment plants reduced pollution emissions, relative to control plants, by 20%–30%. Third, the market reduced abatement costs by an estimated 11%, holding constant emissions. This cost-savings estimate is based on plant-specific marginal cost curves that we estimate from the universe of bids to buy and sell permits in the market. The combination of pollution reductions and low costs imply that the emissions market has mortality benefits that exceed its costs by at least 25 times.
abstract_zh: 基于市场的环境规制在低收入国家很少使用，而这些国家的污染往往最为严重，但国家能力通常较弱。我们与古吉拉特邦污染控制委员会（GPCB）合作，设计并通过实验评估了世界上首个颗粒物排放市场，该市场覆盖了印度一座大城市的工业企业。研究有三项主要发现。第一，该市场运行良好。被随机分配进入排放市场的处理组工厂进行了许可交易，并成为显著的净卖方或净买方。交易之后，处理组工厂持有的许可足以覆盖其99%时间内的排放，而在现行的命令—控制型规制下，合规率仅为66%。第二，相对于对照组工厂，处理组工厂的污染排放减少了20%–30%。第三，在保持排放不变的情况下，该市场估计降低了11%的减排成本。这一成本节约的估计，基于我们从市场中买卖许可的全部报价中估计出的工厂特定边际成本曲线。污染减少与低成本的结合意味着，该排放市场带来的死亡率收益至少是其成本的25倍。

title: Impacts of Climate Change on Global Agriculture Accounting for Adaptation
abstract: Climate change threatens global food systems1, but the extent to which adaptation will reduce losses remains unknown and controversial2. Even within the well-studied context of US agriculture, some analyses argue that adaptation will be widespread and climate damages small3,4, whereas others conclude that adaptation will be limited and losses severe5,6. Scenario-based analyses indicate that adaptation should have notable consequences on global agricultural productivity7–9, but there has been no systematic study of how extensively real-world producers actually adapt at the global scale. Here we empirically estimate the impact of global producer adaptations using longitudinal data on six staple crops spanning 12,658 regions, capturing two-thirds of global crop calories. We estimate that global production declines 5.5 × 1014 kcal annually per 1 °C global mean surface temperature (GMST) rise (120 kcal per person per day or 4.4% of recommended consumption per 1 °C; P < 0.001). We project that adaptation and income growth alleviate 23% of global losses in 2050 and 34% at the end of the century (6% and 12%, respectively; moderate-emissions scenario), but substantial residual losses remain for all staples except rice. In contrast to analyses of other outcomes that project the greatest damages to the global poor10,11, we find that global impacts are dominated by losses to modern-day breadbaskets with favourable climates and limited present adaptation, although losses in low-income regions losses are also substantial. These results indicate a scale of innovation, cropland expansion or further adaptation that might be necessary to ensure food security in a changing climate. Analysis of data on six stable crops, capturing two-thirds of global crop calories, allows estimation of agricultural impacts and the potential of global producer adaptations to reduce output losses owing to climate change.
abstract_zh: 气候变化威胁着全球粮食系统[1]，但适应措施能在多大程度上减少损失，目前仍不清楚且存在争议[2]。即使在研究充分的美国农业背景下，一些分析认为适应将广泛发生，气候损害较小[3,4]，而另一些分析则认为适应将十分有限，损失严重[5,6]。基于情景的分析表明，适应应当对全球农业生产力产生显著影响[7–9]，但目前尚无系统研究考察现实中的生产者在全球范围内究竟在多大程度上进行了适应。在此，我们利用覆盖12,658个地区的六种主要粮食作物的纵向数据，对全球生产者适应的影响进行了实证估计，这些作物占全球作物热量的三分之二。我们估计，全球平均地表温度（GMST）每上升1°C，全球产量每年下降5.5×10^14千卡（相当于每人每天120千卡，或推荐摄入量的4.4%，P < 0.001）。我们预测，到2050年，适应与收入增长将挽回全球损失的23%，到本世纪末将挽回34%（在中等排放情景下，分别为6%和12%）；但除水稻外，所有主粮仍存在大量剩余损失。与其他结果的分析（这些分析预测全球贫困人口将遭受最大损害）[10,11]不同，我们发现全球影响主要由当今气候条件良好、目前适应程度有限的主要粮仓地区的损失所主导，尽管低收入地区的损失也相当可观。这些结果表明，为确保气候变化下的粮食安全，可能需要相应规模的创新、耕地扩张或进一步的适应措施。对覆盖全球作物热量三分之二的六种稳定作物的数据进行分析，使我们能够估计农业影响，以及全球生产者适应减少气候变化所致产出损失的潜力。

title: Man vs. Machine: Technological Promise and Political Limits of Automated Regulation Enforcement
venue: The Review of Economics and Statistics
abstract: New technologies allow perfect detection of environmental violations at near-zero marginal cost, but take-up is low. We conducted a field experiment to evaluate enforcement of water conservation rules with smart meters in Fresno, CA. Households were randomly assigned combinations of enforcement method (automated or in-person inspections) and fines. Automated enforcement increased households’ punishment rates from 0.1 to 14%, decreased summer water use by 3%, and reduced violations by 17%, while higher fine levels had little effect. However, automated enforcement also increased customer complaints by 1,102%, ultimately causing its cancellation and highlighting that political considerations limit technological solutions to enforcement challenges.
abstract_zh: 新技术能够以接近零的边际成本完美地发现环境违规行为，但其采用率却很低。我们开展了一项现场实验，评估了加利福尼亚州弗雷斯诺市利用智能水表执行节水规定的效果。家庭被随机分配到不同的执法方式（自动化检查或现场检查）和罚款组合中。自动化执法使家庭受到处罚的概率从0.1%提高到14%，使夏季用水量减少3%，并使违规行为减少17%，而更高的罚款水平几乎没有效果。然而，自动化执法也使客户投诉增加了1,102%，最终导致其被取消，这表明政治因素限制了技术手段在解决执法难题上的作用。

title: Can Machine Learning Improve the Environment? Evidence from a National Field Test Targeting Hazardous Waste Inspections
abstract: With the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, we developed a machine learning model to predict sites where inspections would uncover severe violations of hazardous waste regulations. We estimate that using our model to target inspections will increase the “hit rate” by 46%. As is often the case, the model’s data are highly selected (representing about ~2% of sites), suggesting that classic selection bias concerns make our estimate’s relevance to the full population unknown. We therefore conducted a national field test of the model’s versus the EPA’s inspection targets; the model’s relative performance was even better, increasing the hit rate by 79%.
abstract_zh: 我们与美国环境保护署合作，开发了一个机器学习模型，用于预测哪些场址的检查会发现危险废物严重违规。我们估计，利用该模型确定检查对象，可将“命中率”提高46%。与许多类似情况一样，该模型的数据高度选择性（仅约占场址的2%），这表明经典的选择偏误问题使我们的估计与全体场址的相关性存在不确定性。因此，我们开展了一项全国性的现场测试，比较该模型与EPA检查目标的表现；结果显示，该模型的相对表现更佳，将命中率提高了79%。

title: Can Cost-Benefit Analysis Rise to the Climate Challenge?
Does the Squeaky Wheel Get More Grease? The Direct and Indirect Effects of Citizen Participation on Environmental Governance in China
Non-Representativeness in Population Health Research: Evidence from a COVID-19 Antibody Study
abstract: We examine data from a serological study that randomized participation incentives ($0, $100, $500). Minority and poor households are underrepresented at lower incentives. We develop a framework that uses randomized incentives to disentangle non-contact and hesitancy and find that underrepresentation occurs because minority and poor households are more hesitant to participate, not because they are harder to contact. In particular, reservation payments for contacted households in minority and poor neighborhoods are substantially more likely to exceed $100. The $500 incentive closes hesitancy gaps and restores representativeness on observable dimensions including hospitalization and insurance rates, and a COVID-19 risk index.

title: The Economics of the Global Energy Challenge
abstract: This lecture argues that, rather than facing an isolated climate change challenge, the world must confront the Global Energy Challenge (GEC) that requires all countries to make trade-offs between three often competing and interrelated goals: inexpensive and reliable energy, clean air, and limiting damages from climate change. I present seven facts that help illuminate the contours of the GEC and the interactions between the three goals. Finally, it concludes by outlining potential solutions: pricing energy at its full social cost, investing in technical and policy innovation, improving information on pollution and climate damages, and treating energy as a private good.
abstract_zh: 本讲座认为，世界面临的并非孤立的气候变化挑战，而是全球能源挑战（GEC），这要求各国在三个常常相互冲突、相互关联的目标之间进行权衡：廉价可靠的能源、清洁的空气，以及限制气候变化造成的损害。我提出了七个事实，以帮助阐明全球能源挑战的轮廓以及三个目标之间的相互作用。最后，本讲座概述了若干潜在解决方案：按照能源的全部社会成本定价，投资于技术和政策创新，改善关于污染和气候损害的信息，以及将能源视为一种私人物品。

title: Is Workplace Temperature a Valuable Job Amenity? Implications for Climate Change
abstract: Using data representing one-third of the world’s population, we ﬁnd that extreme hot and cold days cause substantial labor supply declines for weather-exposed workers, but not for weather-protected workers. With these results and a simple theoretical framework, we calculate that the value of a weather-protected job’s thermal comfort varies widely globally but is worth 2.9% of annual income on average. We project that climate change will increase worker thermal discomfort by 1.8% of global GDP in 2099 under a very high emissions scenario and 0.5% under an intermediate scenario, demonstrating the importance of this new category of climate damages.
abstract_zh: 利用代表世界三分之一人口的数据，我们发现，极端炎热和寒冷的日子会导致受天气影响的工人劳动供给显著下降，而受天气保护的工人则不受影响。基于这些结果以及一个简单的理论框架，我们测算出，受天气保护的工作所提供的热舒适度的价值在全球范围内差异很大，但平均相当于年收入的2.9%。我们预测，在非常高排放情景下，到2099年气候变化将使工人的热不适增加全球GDP的1.8%；在中等排放情景下，这一比例为0.5%。这表明了这一新类别气候损害的重要性。

title: How Large are Methane Emissions from the Upstream Oil and Gas Industry and Why are They There? Evidence from Colorado
Is the Demand for Clean Air Too Low? Experimental Evidence from Delhi
abstract: Do hazardous levels of air pollution in developing countries reflect low demand for air quality or imperfect information about its benefits? This paper implements an experiment to estimate the demand for clean air in a low-income country and tests for several possible market failures in information that may affect it. Combining randomized price variation for low-cost pollution masks with day-to-day variation in ambient air quality, we estimate an average marginal willingness-to-pay (MWTP) for an annual 10 unit reduction in PM2.5 of $1.14 (USD) among low-income residents of Delhi, India. This estimate is low in global terms, but increases more than five times for respondents who are treated with a description of the health effects of air pollution prior to demand elicitation. These findings suggest limited demand for clean air may partly reflect limited information about its benefits.
abstract_zh: 发展中国家的危险空气污染水平，究竟反映的是对空气质量需求低，还是对其收益的信息不完全？本文开展了一项实验，以估计一个低收入国家对清洁空气的需求，并检验可能影响这一需求的若干信息市场失灵。通过将低成本污染口罩的随机价格变化与环境空气质量的日间变化相结合，我们估计，在印度德里的低收入居民中，PM2.5年均降低10个单位的平均边际支付意愿（MWTP）为1.14美元。从全球范围看，这一估计值很低，但在需求询问之前接受了空气污染健康影响说明的受访者中，该数值提高了五倍以上。这些发现表明，对清洁空气需求有限，可能部分反映了人们对其收益的信息有限。

title: Measuring the Welfare Effects of Residential Energy Efficiency Programs
abstract: We introduce a framework to evaluate the welfare effects of residential energy efficiency programs and estimate key parameters using a 100,000-household field experiment. Results generally contradict conventional wisdom: there is no evidence of informational or behavioral market failures, efficiency investments entail large non-monetary costs and benefits, and realized energy savings are just 58% of engineering predictions. The programs we study reduce social welfare by $0.18 per subsidy dollar, because investment subsidies are poorly targeted to externality damages and marginal program participants are unlikely to make externality-reducing investments. Such self-selection may undermine socially desirable program expansion in this and other domains.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个评估居民能效项目福利效应的框架，并利用一项涉及10万户家庭的现场实验估计了关键参数。结果总体上与传统观点相悖：没有证据表明存在信息或行为上的市场失灵；能效投资会带来大量的非货币成本和收益；而实际节能量仅为工程预测值的58%。我们所研究的项目每花费一美元补贴，会使社会福利减少0.18美元，原因在于投资补贴对外部性损害的针对性很差，而边际项目参与者不太可能进行减少外部性的投资。这种自我选择可能会削弱本领域及其他领域中社会期望的项目扩张。

title: Weather, Climate Change and Death in India
abstract: This paper reveals a stark inequality in the effect of ambient temperatures on death in human populations. Using district-level daily weather and annual mortality data from 1957 to 2000, we find that hot days lead to substantial increases in mortality in rural but not urban India. Despite being far poorer, the mortality response in urban India is not dissimilar to that in the US over the same period. Looking into potential mechanisms we find that the rural death effects are driven by hot days in the growing season which reduce productivity and wages in agriculture. Consistent with a model of endogenous survival in the face of credit constraints, we also find that the expansion of bank branches into rural India helped to mitigate these effects. When coupled with a climatological model that predicts many more hot days in a typical year by the end of this century, these estimates imply considerable reductions in rural Indian, but not urban Indian or US, life expectancy ceteris paribus.
abstract_zh: 本文揭示了环境气温对人口死亡影响方面一种鲜明的不平等。利用1957年至2000年地区层面的逐日天气数据和年度死亡率数据，我们发现，炎热的日子会导致印度农村地区死亡率大幅上升，而城市地区则不然。尽管城市居民远比农村居民富裕，但印度城市地区的死亡率反应与同期美国并无太大差异。在探究可能的机制时，我们发现，农村的死亡效应是由生长季的炎热天气驱动的，这会降低农业生产率和工资。与存在信贷约束下内生生存模型相一致，我们还发现，银行网点向印度农村的扩张有助于缓解这些影响。结合一个预测本世纪末典型年份将出现更多炎热日子的气候模型，这些估计意味着，在其他条件不变的情况下，印度农村的预期寿命将显著下降，而印度城市和美国的预期寿命则不会受到明显影响。

title: DSCIM-Coastal v1.1: An Open-Source Modeling Platform for Global Impacts of Sea Level Rise
abstract:
Sea level rise (SLR) may impose substantial economic costs to coastal communities worldwide, but characterizing its global impact remains challenging because SLR costs depend heavily on natural characteristics and human investments at each location – including topography, the spatial distribution of assets, and local adaptation decisions. To date, several impact models have been developed to estimate the global costs of SLR. Yet, the limited availability of open-source and modular platforms that easily ingest up-to-date socioeconomic and physical data sources restricts the ability of existing systems to incorporate new insights transparently. In this paper, we present a modular, open-source platform designed to address this need, providing end-to-end transparency from global input data to a scalable least-cost optimization framework that estimates adaptation and net SLR costs for nearly 10 000 global coastline segments and administrative regions. Our approach accounts both for uncertainty in the magnitude of global mean sea level (g.m.s.l.) rise and spatial variability in local relative sea level rise. Using this platform, we evaluate costs across 230 possible socioeconomic and SLR trajectories in the 21st century. According to the latest Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change Assessment Report (AR6), g.m.s.l. is likely to rise during the 21st century by 0.40–0.69 m if late-century warming reaches 2

C of warming (Fox-Kemper et al., 2021). With no forward-looking adaptation, we estimate that annual costs of sea level rise associated with a 2
∘
C scenario will likely fall between USD 1.2 and 4.0 trillion (0.1 % and 1.2 % of GDP, respectively) by 2100, depending on socioeconomic and sea level rise trajectories. Cost-effective, proactive adaptation would provide substantial benefits, lowering these values to between USD 110 and USD 530 billion (0.02 and 0.06 %) under an optimal adaptation scenario. For the likely SLR trajectories associated with 4
∘
C warming, these costs range from USD 3.1 to 6.9 trillion (0.3 % and 2.0 %) with no forward-looking adaptation and USD 200 billion to USD 750 billion (0.04 % to 0.09 %) under optimal adaptation. The Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) notes that deeply uncertain physical processes like marine ice cliff instability could drive substantially higher global sea level rise, potentially approaching 2.0 m by 2100 in very high emission scenarios. Accordingly, we also model the impacts of 1.5 and 2.0 m g.m.s.l. rises by 2100; the associated annual cost estimates range from USD 11.2 to 30.6 trillion (1.2 % and 7.6 %) under no forward-looking adaptation and USD 420 billion to 1.5 trillion (0.08 % to 0.20 %) under optimal adaptation. Our modeling platform used to generate these estimates is publicly available in an effort to spur research collaboration and support decision-making, with segment-level physical and socioeconomic input characteristics provided at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.7693868 (Bolliger et al., 2023a) and model results at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.7693869 (Bolliger et al., 2023b).
abstract_zh: 海平面上升（SLR）可能给全球沿海社区带来巨大的经济成本，但刻画其全球影响仍然具有挑战性，因为海平面上升的成本在很大程度上取决于各地的自然特征和人类投资，包括地形、资产的空间分布以及当地的适应决策。迄今为止，已开发了若干影响模型来估算海平面上升的全球成本。然而，能够便捷地纳入最新社会经济和物理数据源的开源、模块化平台十分有限，这限制了现有系统透明地纳入新见解的能力。在本文中，我们提出了一个为满足这一需求而设计的模块化开源平台，它实现了从全球输入数据到可扩展的最低成本优化框架的全流程透明，可估计近10,000个全球海岸线分段和行政区的适应成本及海平面上升净成本。我们的方法既考虑了全球平均海平面（g.m.s.l.）上升幅度的不确定性，也考虑了局地相对海平面上升的空间差异。利用该平台，我们评估了21世纪230种可能的社会经济和海平面上升路径下的成本。根据政府间气候变化专门委员会（IPCC）最新的第六次评估报告（AR6），若本世纪末变暖达到2°C，21世纪全球平均海平面可能上升0.40–0.69米；若变暖达到4°C，则可能上升0.58–0.91米（Fox-Kemper等，2021）。在不进行前瞻性适应的情况下，我们估计，在2°C情景下，到2100年，海平面上升每年造成的成本可能在1.2万亿至4.0万亿美元之间（分别相当于GDP的0.1%和1.2%），具体取决于社会经济和海平面上升路径。具有成本效益的主动适应将带来可观收益，在最优适应情景下，这些数值可降至1,100亿至5,300亿美元（分别为0.02%和0.06%）。对于与4°C变暖相关的可能海平面上升路径，在不进行前瞻性适应时，这些成本为3.1万亿至6.9万亿美元（分别为0.3%和2.0%）；在最优适应情景下，则为2,000亿至7,500亿美元（0.04%至0.09%）。IPCC指出，海洋冰崖不稳定等具有深刻不确定性的物理过程可能导致全球海平面大幅上升，在极高排放情景下，到2100年可能接近2.0米。因此，我们还模拟了到2100年全球平均海平面上升1.5米和2.0米的影响；相应的年度成本估计值为：在不进行前瞻性适应时为11.2万亿至30.6万亿美元（分别为1.2%和7.6%），在最优适应情景下为4,200亿至1.5万亿美元（0.08%至0.20%）。我们用于生成这些估计的建模平台已公开发布，以推动研究合作并支持决策；分段层面的物理和社会经济输入特征见https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.7693868（Bolliger等，2023a），模型结果见https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.7693869（Bolliger等，2023b）。

title: Mandatory Disclosure Would Reveal Corporate Carbon Damages
abstract: The US Securities and Exchange Commission recently proposed a rule that would mandate that public companies report their greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions. This follows similar efforts in the European Union (EU) and United Kingdom. One rationale is that disclosure will provide information on material risks to investors, making it evident which firms are most exposed to future climate policies. In addition, some believe that reporting will galvanize pressure from companies’ key stakeholders (e.g., customers and employees), leading them to voluntarily reduce their emissions. This reasoning is in line with evidence for financial markets and disclosure mandates that form the third wave of environmental policy, which follows a wave of direct regulation and a wave of market-based approaches. But what might such disclosure reveal? We provide a first-cut preview of what we might learn about the climate damages caused by each company’s GHG emissions by drawing on one of the largest global datasets, which covers roughly 15,000 public companies.
abstract_zh: 美国证券交易委员会近期提出一项规则，拟强制上市公司报告其温室气体（GHG）排放。此前欧盟和英国也有类似举措。其理由之一是，披露将为投资者提供有关重大风险的信息，从而清楚地显示哪些企业最容易受到未来气候政策的影响。此外，一些人认为，披露报告将激发企业主要利益相关方（例如客户和员工）施加压力，促使其自愿减少排放。这一逻辑与有关金融市场和披露强制要求的证据相一致，后者构成了继直接规制浪潮和市场化机制浪潮之后的第三波环境政策。但此类披露究竟会揭示什么？我们利用全球规模最大的数据集之一（涵盖约15,000家上市公司），对每家公司温室气体排放所造成的气候损害可能会揭示什么，给出了初步的预览。

title: Selection Bias in Voluntary Random Testing: Evidence from a COVID-19 Antibody Study
venue: American Economic Association Papers and Proceedings
abstract: We use data from a serological study that experimentally varied financial incentives for participation to detect and characterize selection bias. Participants are from neighborhoods with substantially lower COVID-19 risks. Existing methods to account for the resulting selection bias produce wide bounds or estimates that are inconsistent with the population. One explanation for these inconsistent estimates is that the underlying methods presume a single dimension of unobserved heterogeneity. The data suggest that there are two types of nonparticipants with opposing selection patterns. Allowing for these different types may lead to better accounting for selection bias.

title: A Guide to Updating the US Government’s Social Cost of Carbon
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: Since its release in 2010, the US government’s social cost of carbon (SCC) has played a central role in climate policy both domestically and internationally. However, rapid progress in climate science and economics over the past decade means that the original SCC estimate is no longer based on the frontier of scientific knowledge. Specifically, extensive new research about the climate, the economy, and their relationship has altered our understanding of the magnitudes of the projected physical and economic impacts of climate change, as well as their heterogeneity across space and time. This article, which was written as the Biden presidential administration was actively rebuilding the US SCC, provides concrete recommendations on how to base the SCC on the most recent research advances and thus return it to the scientific frontier.
abstract_zh: 自2010年发布以来，美国政府的碳的社会成本（SCC）在国内外气候政策中都发挥了核心作用。然而，过去十年间气候科学和经济学的快速进展意味着，最初的SCC估计已不再基于科学知识的前沿。具体而言，关于气候、经济及其相互关系的大量新研究，改变了我们对气候变化所预测的物理和经济影响规模，以及其在空间和时间上异质性的认识。本文撰写于拜登政府积极重建美国SCC之际，就如何以最新研究进展为基础确定SCC、使其重回科学前沿，提出了具体建议。

title: Can Technology Solve the Principal-Agent Problem? Evidence from China’s War on Air Pollution
abstract: We examine the introduction of automatic air pollution monitoring to counter suspected tampering at the local level, a central feature of China’s “war on pollution.” Exploiting 654 regression discontinuity designs based on city-level variation in the day that monitoring was automated, we find an immediate and lasting increase of 35 percent in reported PM10 concentrations post-automation. Moreover, automation’s introduction increased online searches for face masks and air filters, which are strong predictors of purchases. Overall, our findings suggest that the biased and imperfect information prior to automation led to suboptimal investments in defensive measures, plausibly imposing meaningful welfare costs. (JEL D82, O13, P28, Q53, Q55, Q58)
abstract_zh: 我们考察了为应对地方层面涉嫌篡改数据的问题而引入自动化空气污染监测的情况，这是中国“污染防治攻坚战”的一个核心特征。利用基于城市层面自动化监测启用日期差异构建的654个断点回归设计，我们发现，自动化之后，报告的PM10浓度立即且持久地上升了35%。此外，自动化的引入还增加了对口罩和空气过滤器的网络搜索，而这些搜索是购买行为的有力预测指标。总体而言，我们的发现表明，自动化之前有偏且不完善的信息导致了防御性措施投资的次优，可能带来了可观的福利损失。（JEL D82, O13, P28, Q53, Q55, Q58）

title: Valuing the Global Mortality Consequences of Climate Change Accounting for Adaptation Costs and Benefits
abstract: Using 40 countries’ subnational data, we estimate age-specific mortality-temperature relationships and extrapolate them to countries without data today and into a future with climate change. We uncover a U-shaped relationship where extre6me cold and hot temperatures increase mortality rates, especially for the elderly. Critically, this relationship is flattened by higher incomes and adaptation to local climate. Using a revealed-preference approach to recover unobserved adaptation costs, we estimate that the mean global increase in mortality risk due to climate change, accounting for adaptation benefits and costs, is valued at roughly 3.2% of global GDP in 2100 under a high-emissions scenario. Notably, today’s cold locations are projected to benefit, while today’s poor and hot locations have large projected damages. Finally, our central estimates indicate that the release of an additional ton of CO2 today will cause mortality-related damages of $36.6 under a high-emissions scenario, with an interquartile range accounting for both econometric and climate uncertainty of [−$7.8, $73.0]. These empirically grounded estimates exceed the previous literature’s estimates by an order of magnitude.
abstract_zh: 利用40个国家的次国家级数据，我们估计了分年龄组的死亡率与温度之间的关系，并将其外推至当前缺乏数据的国家以及气候变化背景下的未来情景。我们发现了一种U形关系：极端的低温和高温会提高死亡率，对老年人尤为明显。关键在于，这一关系会因收入水平提高和当地气候适应而趋于平缓。我们采用显示性偏好方法（revealed-preference approach）来推算不可观测的适应成本，估计在高排放情景下，考虑适应收益与适应成本之后，气候变化导致的全球平均死亡风险增加在2100年约相当于全球GDP的3.2%。值得注意的是，当前较为寒冷的地区预计将从中受益，而当前贫穷且炎热的地区预计将遭受巨大损失。最后，我们的中心估计表明，在高排放情景下，当前每排放一吨CO2将造成36.6美元的死亡率相关损害，若同时考虑计量经济学不确定性与气候不确定性，其四分位距为[−7.8美元，73.0美元]。这些基于经验证据的估计，比以往文献的估计高出一个数量级。

title: China’s War on Pollution: Evidence from the First Five Years
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: The decade from 2010 to 2019 marked a significant turning point in China’s history of environmental regulation and pollution. This article describes the recent trends in air and water quality, with a focus on the five years since China declared a “war on pollution” in 2014. It summarizes the emerging literature that has taken advantage of accompanying improvements in data availability and accuracy to document sharp improvements in environmental quality, especially local air pollution, and understand their social, economic, and health consequences.
abstract_zh: 2010年至2019年的十年，是中国环境规制与污染历史上的重要转折点。本文描述了近期空气和水质的变化趋势，重点关注中国于2014年宣布“向污染宣战”以来的五年。文章总结了一批新兴文献，这些文献利用数据可得性和准确性的同步提升，记录了环境质量（尤其是当地空气污染）的显著改善，并考察了其社会、经济和健康后果。

title: Do Conservation Policies Work? Evidence from Residential Water Use
venue: Environmental and Energy Policy and the Economy
abstract: In response to the historic 2011–17 California drought, local governments enacted a raft of conservation policies, and little is known about which ones explain the sharp decline in residential water consumption. To answer this question, we use a novel data set of hourly water consumption data for more than 82,300 households in Fresno, California, where water consumption declined by nearly a third, and have three main findings. First, we estimate the price elasticity of demand for water to be 0.16 for marginal rates and 0.39 for average rates. Second, reducing the number of days where outdoor watering is allowable from 3 to 2 substantially decreases water use, despite the availability of opportunities to substitute between permitted and nonpermitted hours, days, and seasons. Third, “bully pulpit” pronouncements about the water crisis increased public awareness of drought conditions but did not contribute to water savings. Overall, higher water prices explain 40%–44% of the changes in residential water use observed during our sample period in Fresno, and reductions in the number of days when outdoor watering is allowable explain 45%–51% of these changes. However, the absence of experimental or quasi-experimental variation in these policies means that we interpret this associational evidence cautiously.
abstract_zh: 为应对2011年至2017年加利福尼亚州的历史性干旱，地方政府颁布了一系列节水政策，但人们对于究竟哪些政策能够解释居民用水量的急剧下降知之甚少。为回答这一问题，我们使用了一个新颖的数据集，其中包含加利福尼亚州弗雷斯诺市超过82,300户家庭的逐时用水数据，该市居民用水量下降了近三分之一。我们有三项主要发现。第一，我们估计用水的需求价格弹性：边际水价的弹性为0.16，平均水价的弹性为0.39。第二，将允许户外浇水的天数从3天减少为2天，显著降低了用水量，尽管人们可以在允许与不允许的时段、日期和季节之间进行替代。第三，关于水危机的“讲台宣言”式表态提高了公众对干旱状况的认识，但并未带来节水效果。总体而言，较高的水价解释了我们样本期内弗雷斯诺市居民用水变化的40%–44%，而允许户外浇水天数的减少则解释了这些变化的45%–51%。然而，由于这些政策缺乏实验或准实验变异，我们对这些关联性证据的解释应保持谨慎。

title: Estimating a Social Cost of Carbon for Global Energy Consumption
abstract: Estimates of global economic damage caused by carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions can inform climate policy. The social cost of carbon (SCC) quantifies these damages by characterizing how additional CO2 emissions today impact future economic outcomes through altering the climate. Previous estimates suggest that large, warming-driven increases in energy expenditures could dominate the SCC, but they rely on models that are spatially coarse and not tightly linked to data. Here we show that the release of 1t CO2 today is projected to reduce total future energy expenditures, with most estimates valued between -$3 and -$1, depending on discount rates. Our results are based on a new architecture that integrates global data, econometrics, and climate science to estimate local dam- ages worldwide. Notably, we project that emerging economies in the tropics will dramatically increase electricity consumption due to warming, requiring critical infrastructure planning. However, heating reductions in colder countries offset this increase globally. We estimate that 2099 global electricity consumption rises ∼ 4.5 EJ/yr (7% current global consumption) while direct consumption of other fuels declines ∼ 11.3 EJ/yr (7% current consumption) per +1◦C increase in global mean temperature. Our finding of net savings contradicts previous research, because global data indicate that many populations will remain too poor for most of the 21st century to substantially increase energy consumption in response to warming. Importantly, damage estimates would differ if poorer populations were given greater weight.
abstract_zh: 对二氧化碳（CO2）排放造成的全球经济损害进行估计，可以为气候政策提供依据。碳的社会成本（SCC）刻画了当前额外的二氧化碳排放如何通过改变气候而影响未来的经济结果，从而量化这些损害。以往的估计表明，由变暖驱动的能源支出大幅增加可能主导碳的社会成本，但这些估计依赖于空间粗糙且与数据联系不紧密的模型。在此我们表明，当前排放1吨二氧化碳预计将减少未来的总能源支出，根据不同的贴现率，大多数估计值介于负3美元至负1美元之间。我们的结果基于一种新的架构，该架构整合了全球数据、计量经济学和气候科学，以估计全球各地的局部损害。值得注意的是，我们预测热带新兴经济体的电力消耗将因变暖而大幅增加，这需要关键的基础设施规划。然而，寒冷国家供暖需求的减少在全球范围内抵消了这一增长。我们估计，全球平均气温每上升1°C，到2099年全球电力消费将增加约4.5艾焦/年（相当于当前全球消费的7%），而其他燃料的直接消费将减少约11.3艾焦/年（相当于当前消费的7%）。我们关于净节约的发现与以往研究相矛盾，原因在于全球数据表明，许多人口在二十一世纪大部分时间里仍将过于贫穷，无法因变暖而大幅增加能源消费。重要的是，如果赋予较贫穷人口更大的权重，损害估计将会有所不同。

title: Indoor Air Quality, Information, and Socioeconomic Status: Evidence from Delhi
venue: American Economic Association Papers and Proceedings
abstract: In Delhi, one of the world's most polluted cities, there is relatively little information on indoor air pollution and how it varies by socioeconomic status (SES). Using indoor air quality monitors (IAQMs), we find that winter levels of household air pollution exceed World Health Organization standards by more than 20 times in both high-and low-SES households. We then evaluate a field experiment that randomly assigned monthlong IAQM user trials across medium-and high-SES households but suffered from significant survey non-response. Among respondents, IAQMs did not affect take-up of subsidized air purifier rentals or other defensive behavior.
abstract_zh: 德里是世界污染最严重的城市之一，但关于室内空气污染及其随社会经济地位（SES）变化的信息相对较少。利用室内空气质量监测仪（IAQM），我们发现，在高社会经济地位和低社会经济地位家庭中，冬季的家庭空气污染水平均超过世界卫生组织标准20倍以上。随后，我们评估了一项现场实验，该实验将为期一个月的IAQM使用试验随机分配给中等和高社会经济地位家庭，但存在严重的调查无应答问题。在有应答的受访者中，IAQM并未影响其对补贴空气净化器租赁服务的采用，也未影响其他防御性行为。

title: The Heterogeneous Value of a Statistical Life: Evidence from U.S. Army Reenlistment Decisions
venue: Becker Friedman Institute for Economics WP
abstract: We estimate the value of a statistical life (VSL), or the willingness to trade-off wealth and mortality risk, among 430,000 U.S. Army soldiers choosing whether to reenlist from 2002-2010. Using a discrete choice random utility approach and significant variation in retention bonuses and mortality risk, we recover average VSL estimates between $500,000 and $900,000, an order of magnitude smaller than U.S. civilian labor market estimates. We then document substantial heterogeneity by recovering indifference curves between wealth and mortality risk. The VSL increases with mortality risk within type, and soldiers in combat occupations have lower VSLs than those in noncombat occupations.

title: Do Credit Market Shocks Affect the Real Economy? Quasi-Experimental Evidence from the Great Recession and ‘Normal’ Economic Times
abstract: Using comprehensive data on bank lending and establishment-level outcomes from 1997–2010, this paper finds that small business lending is an unimportant determinant of small business and overall economic activity. A shift-share style research design is implemented to predict county-level lending shocks using variation in preexisting bank market shares and bank supply shifts. Counties with negative predicted lending shocks experienced declines in small business loan originations, indicating that it is costly to switch lenders. However, small business loan originations have an economically insignificant and generally statistically insignificant impact on both small firm and overall employment during the Great Recession and normal times.

title: Does Social Distancing Matter?
abstract: This paper develops and implements a method to monetize the impact of moderate social distancing on deaths from COVID-19. Using the Ferguson et al. (2020) simulation model of COVID-19’s spread and mortality impacts in the United States, we project that 3-4 months of moderate distancing beginning in late March 2020 would save 1.7 million lives by October 1. Of the lives saved, 630,000 are due to avoided overwhelming of hospital intensive care units. Using the projected age-specific reductions in death and age-varying estimates of the United States Government’s value of a statistical life, we find that the mortality benefits of social distancing are about $8 trillion or $60,000 per US household. Roughly 90% of the monetized benefits are projected to accrue to people age 50 or older. Overall, the analysis suggests that social distancing initiatives and policies in response to the COVID-19 epidemic have substantial economic benefits.

title: Fuel Economy 2.0
abstract: Motor vehicle fuel-economy standards have long been a cornerstone of U.S. policy to reduce fuel consumption in the light-duty vehicle fleet. In 2010 and 2012, these standards were significantly expanded in an effort to achieve steep reductions in oil demand and greenhouse gas (“GHG”) emissions through 2025. In 2018, following a review of the standards, the Environmental Protection Agency and National Highway Traffic Safety Administration proposed instead to freeze the standards at 2020 levels, citing high program costs (and potential safety issues). The current debate over the future of U.S. fuel economy standards provides an opportunity to consider whether the existing approach could be improved to achieve environmental and other goals at a lower cost. The current policy prescribes standards that focus on fuel economy alone, as opposed to lifetime consumption, and treats vehicle categories differentially, meaning that it imposes unnecessarily high costs and does not deliver guaranteed GHG savings. On the basis of a commitment to cost-benefit analysis, which has defined U.S. regulatory policy for more than thirty years, we propose novel reforms with three main features: (1) the direct regulation of expected fuel consumption and GHG emissions without consideration of the type or size of the vehicle; (2) use of existing data to assign lifetime fuel consumption and GHG emissions to each model; and (3) creation of a robust cap-and-trade market for automakers to reduce compliance costs. We show that these reforms would reduce fuel consumption and GHG emissions in transportation with greater certainty and do so at a far lower cost per ton of GHG emissions avoided. We also show that the Environmental Protection Agency and the Department of Transportation could implement such an approach within their existing statutory authority.
abstract_zh: 机动车燃油经济性标准长期以来是美国减少轻型车队燃料消耗政策的基石。2010年和2012年，这些标准被大幅扩展，以期到2025年大幅减少石油需求和温室气体（“GHG”）排放。2018年，在对这些标准进行审查后，美国环境保护署和国家公路交通安全管理局转而提议将标准冻结在2020年的水平，理由是项目成本高昂（以及潜在的安全问题）。当前关于美国燃油经济性标准未来走向的争论，为我们考虑现有制度能否加以改进，以更低的成本实现环境及其他目标，提供了契机。现行政策所规定的标准只关注燃油经济性本身，而不考虑全生命周期的消耗，并且对不同车辆类别区别对待，这意味着它施加了不必要的高成本，且无法保证带来温室气体减排。基于对成本收益分析的承诺（三十多年来，该分析一直定义着美国的规制政策），我们提出了具有三个主要特征的新颖改革方案：（1）直接规制预期燃料消耗和温室气体排放，而不考虑车辆的类型或尺寸；（2）利用现有数据，为每款车型分配全生命周期的燃料消耗和温室气体排放；（3）为汽车制造商建立稳健的总量控制与交易市场，以降低合规成本。我们表明，这些改革将以更大的确定性减少交通领域的燃料消耗和温室气体排放，并且每吨温室气体减排的成本要低得多。我们还表明，美国环境保护署和交通部可以在其现有法定权限内实施这一方案。

title: Job Loss and Behavioral Change: The Unprecedented Effects of the India Lockdown in Delhi
abstract: On March 24, 2020, the Prime Minister of India announced the world’s largest COVID-19 lockdown. We summarize the initial impacts of the lockdown for a representative sample of mostly poor and non-migrant workers in Delhi. Using Facebook mobility data, we show that intra-city movement dropped 80 percent following the announcement. Using microeconomic survey data, collected before and during the crisis, we highlight three patterns. First, the lockdown resulted in significant economic costs, with income and days worked falling by 57 and 73 percent, respectively. Second, the lockdown resulted in widespread compliance with public health directives: mask usage rose by 73 percentage points (pp); time spent indoors increased by 51 pp; smoking decreased by 13 pp; and handwashing rose by 10 pp. Third, the economic impacts of the lockdown were somewhat mitigated by government food assistance, which 36 percent of our sample accessed. Over the first seven weeks of the lockdown, we do not observe alarming levels of hunger, scarcity, access to medical care, or security. Yet in our data, concerns remain about mental health, supply chains, and personal savings, against the backdrop of a rising infection rate. Moreover, it remains to be seen whether public health compliance will persist, as the novelty, fear, and media coverage of COVID-19 subside.

title: The Consequences of Treating Electricity as a Right
abstract: This paper seeks to explain why billions of people in developing countries either have no access to electricity or lack a reliable supply. We present evidence that these shortfalls are a consequence of electricity being treated as a right and that this sets off a vicious four-step circle. In step 1, because a social norm has developed that all deserve power independent of payment, subsidies, theft, and nonpayment are widely tolerated. In step 2, electricity distribution companies lose money with each unit of electricity sold and in total lose large sums of money. In step 3, government-owned distribution companies ration supply to limit losses by restricting access and hours of supply. In step 4, power supply is no longer governed by market forces and the link between payment and supply is severed, thus reducing customers’ incentives to pay. The equilibrium outcome is uneven and sporadic access that undermines growth.
abstract_zh: 本文试图解释，为何发展中国家有数十亿人要么无法获得电力，要么无法获得可靠的供电。我们提供的证据表明，这些供电短缺是将电力视为一项权利的结果，并引发了一个恶性的四步循环。第一步，由于社会规范已经形成，认为所有人无论是否付费都应当获得电力，因此补贴、窃电和拖欠电费被广泛容忍。第二步，配电公司每售出一单位电力都会亏损，总体亏损数额巨大。第三步，国有配电公司通过限制接入和供电时长来配给供应，以限制损失。第四步，电力供应不再受市场力量支配，付费与供电之间的联系被切断，从而削弱了用户付费的激励。最终的均衡结果是不均衡且断断续续的供电，这损害了经济增长。

title: The Local Economic and Welfare Consequences of Hydraulic Fracturing
abstract: Exploiting geological variation within shale deposits and timing in the initiation of hydraulic fracturing, this paper finds that allowing fracing leads to sharp increases in oil and gas recovery and improvements in a wide set of economic indicators. At the same time, estimated willingnessto-pay (WTP) for the decrease in local amenities (e.g., crime and noise) is roughly equal to -$1000 to -$1,600 per household annually (-1.9% to -3.1% of mean household income).Overall, we estimate that WTP for allowing fracing equals about $1,300 to $1,900 per household annually (2.5% to 3.7%), although there is substantial heterogeneity across shale regions.
abstract_zh: 利用页岩矿床内的地质差异以及水力压裂开始实施的时间，本文发现，允许进行压裂作业会使石油和天然气产量急剧增加，并使一系列经济指标得到改善。与此同时，居民为当地环境舒适度（如犯罪和噪音）的下降所愿意支付的金额（WTP）估计约为每户每年-1000美元至-1600美元（占家庭平均收入的-1.9%至-3.1%）。总体而言，我们估计，允许压裂作业的WTP约为每户每年1300美元至1900美元（占2.5%至3.7%），不过各页岩区域之间存在显著的异质性。

title: Do Energy Efficiency Investments Deliver? Evidence from the Weatherization Assistance Program
abstract: A growing number of policies and programs aim to increase investment in energy efficiency, because conventional wisdom suggests that people fail to take-up these investments even though they have positive private returns and generate environmental benefits. Many explanations for this energy efficiency gap have been put forward but there has been surprisingly little field testing of whether the conventional wisdom is correct. This paper reports on the results of an experimental evaluation of the nation’s largest residential energy efficiency program – the Weatherization Assistance Program – conducted on a sample of approximately 30,000 households in Michigan. The findings suggest that the upfront investment costs are about twice the actual energy savings. Further, the model-projected savings are more than three times the actual savings. While this might be attributed to the “rebound” effect – when demand for energy end uses increases as a result of greater efficiency – the paper fails to find evidence of significantly higher indoor temperatures at weatherized homes. Even when accounting for the broader societal benefits derived from emissions reductions, the costs still substantially outweigh the benefits; the average rate of return is approximately -7.8% annually.
abstract_zh: 越来越多的政策和计划旨在增加节能投资，因为通行观点认为，尽管此类投资具有正的私人收益并能带来环境效益，人们却未能采纳。关于这种“能源效率缺口”，已经提出了许多解释，但令人惊讶的是，对于通行观点是否正确，实地检验却很少。本文报告了对全美规模最大的住宅节能计划——住房节能改造援助计划（Weatherization Assistance Program）——进行的实验评估结果，样本为密歇根州约30,000户家庭。研究结果表明，前期投资成本约为实际节能量的两倍。此外，模型预测的节能量是实际节能量的三倍多。虽然这可能归因于“反弹效应”——即能源效率提高后，能源终端用途的需求随之增加——但本文并未发现改造后住房室内温度显著升高的证据。即便考虑到减排所带来的更广泛的社会效益，成本仍大大超过收益；平均年收益率约为-7.8%。

title: The Lancet Commission on Pollution and Health
abstract: Pollution is the largest environmental cause of disease and premature death in the world today. Diseases caused by pollution were responsible for an estimated 9 million premature deaths in 2015—16% of all deaths worldwide—three times more deaths than from AIDS, tuberculosis, and malaria combined and 15 times more than from all wars and other forms of violence. In the most severely affected countries, pollution-related disease is responsible for more than one death in four. Pollution disproportionately kills the poor and the vulnerable. Nearly 92% of pollution-related deaths occur in low-income and middle-income countries and, in countries at every income level, disease caused by pollution is most prevalent among minorities and the marginalised. Children are at high risk of pollution-related disease and even extremely low-dose exposures to pollutants during windows of vulnerability in utero and in early infancy can result in disease, disability, and death in childhood and across their lifespan.
abstract_zh: 污染是当今世界最大的环境致病和过早死亡原因。2015年，污染相关疾病造成约900万人过早死亡，占全球死亡人数的16%，是艾滋病、结核病和疟疾合计死亡人数的三倍，是所有战争和其他形式暴力死亡人数的15倍。在受影响最严重的国家，污染相关疾病导致的死亡占比超过四分之一。污染对贫困人群和弱势群体的伤害尤为严重。近92%的污染相关死亡发生在低收入和中等收入国家；在各收入水平的国家中，污染相关疾病在少数族裔和边缘群体中最为普遍。儿童是污染相关疾病的高危人群，即使在子宫内和婴儿早期等脆弱窗口期接触极低剂量的污染物，也可能在儿童期及其整个生命周期中导致疾病、残疾和死亡。

title: The Value of Regulatory Discretion: Estimates from Environmental Inspections in India
abstract: In collaboration with a state environmental regulator in India, we conducted a field experiment to raise the frequency of environmental inspections to the prescribed minimum for a random set of industrial plants. The treatment was successful when judged by process measures, as treatment plants, relative to the control group, were more than twice as likely to be inspected and to be cited for violating pollution standards. Yet the treatment was weaker for more consequential outcomes: the regulator was no more likely to identify extreme polluters (i.e., plants with emissions five times the regulatory standard or more) or to impose costly penalties in the treatment group. In response to the added scrutiny, treatment plants only marginally increased compliance with standards and did not significantly reduce mean pollution emissions. To explain these results and recover the full costs of environmental regulation, we model the regulatory process as a dynamic discrete game where the regulator chooses whether to penalize and plants choose whether to abate to avoid future sanctions. We estimate this model using original data on 10,000 interactions between plants and the regulator. Our estimates imply that the costs of environmental regulation are largely reserved for extremely polluting plants. Applying the cost estimates to the experimental data, we find the average treatment inspection imposes about half the cost on plants that the average control inspection does, because the randomly assigned inspections in the treatment are less likely than normal discretionary inspections to target such extreme polluters.
abstract_zh: 我们与印度一个邦的环境监管机构合作开展了一项田野实验，针对随机选取的一组工业工厂，将环境检查的频率提高到规定的最低标准。若以过程指标衡量，该处理是成功的：相较于对照组，处理组的工厂被检查的可能性和因违反污染标准而被处罚的可能性都高出一倍以上。然而，该处理对更重要的结果影响较弱：监管机构并未更有可能识别出极端污染者（即排放量达到监管标准五倍或以上的工厂），也未更有可能在处理组中施加高昂的罚款。面对额外的监督，处理组工厂仅略微提高了达标率，且并未显著降低平均污染排放量。为解释这些结果并还原环境监管的全部成本，我们将监管过程建模为一个动态离散博弈：监管机构选择是否处罚，工厂则选择是否减排以避免未来的制裁。我们利用10,000次工厂与监管机构互动的原始数据对该模型进行了估计。估计结果表明，环境监管的成本主要由污染极其严重的工厂承担。将成本估计结果应用于实验数据后，我们发现，处理组的平均检查给工厂带来的成本约为对照组平均检查的一半，原因在于随机分配的处理组检查比正常的自主检查更不可能针对此类极端污染者。

title: Defensive Investments and the Demand for Air Quality: Evidence from the NOx Budget Program
abstract: The demand for air quality depends on health impacts and defensive investments, but little research assesses the empirical importance of defenses. A rich quasi-experiment suggests that the Nitrogen Oxides (NOx) Budget Program (NBP), a cap-and-trade market, decreased NOx emissions, ambient ozone concentrations, pharmaceutical expenditures, and mortality rates. The annual reductions in pharmaceutical purchases, a key defensive investment, and mortality are valued at about $800 million and $1.3 billion, respectively, suggesting that defenses are over one-third of willingness-to-pay for reductions in NOx emissions. Further, estimates indicate that the NBP's benefits easily exceed its costs and that NOx reductions have substantial benefits. (JEL I12, Q51, Q53, Q58)
abstract_zh: 对空气质量的需求取决于健康影响和防御性投资，但很少有研究评估防御性投资的实证重要性。一项丰富的准实验表明，氮氧化物（NOx）预算计划（NBP）——一个总量控制与交易市场——降低了NOx排放、近地面臭氧浓度、药品支出和死亡率。作为关键防御性投资的药品购买量与死亡率的年度减少，分别估值约为8亿美元和13亿美元，这表明防御性投资占减少NOx排放的支付意愿的三分之一以上。此外，估计结果显示，NBP的收益轻松超过其成本，且NOx减排具有可观的收益。（JEL分类号：I12, Q51, Q53, Q58）

title: Hydraulic Fracturing and Infant Health: New Evidence from Pennsylvania
abstract: The development of hydraulic fracturing ("fracking") is considered the biggest change to the global energy production system in the last half-century. However, several communities have banned fracking because of unresolved concerns about the impact of this process on human health. To evaluate the potential health impacts of fracking, we analyzed records of more than 1.1 million births in Pennsylvania from 2004 to 2013, comparing infants born to mothers living at different distances from active fracking sites and those born both before and after fracking was initiated at each site. We adjusted for fixed maternal determinants of infant health by comparing siblings who were and were not exposed to fracking sites in utero. We found evidence for negative health effects of in utero exposure to fracking sites within 3 km of a mother's residence, with the largest health impacts seen for in utero exposure within 1 km of fracking sites. Negative health impacts include a greater incidence of low-birth weight babies as well as significant declines in average birth weight and in several other measures of infant health. There is little evidence for health effects at distances beyond 3 km, suggesting that health impacts of fracking are highly local. Informal estimates suggest that about 29,000 of the nearly 4 million annual U.S. births occur within 1 km of an active fracking site and that these births therefore may be at higher risk of poor birth outcomes.
abstract_zh: 水力压裂（“压裂法”）的发展被视为过去半个世纪中全球能源生产体系所经历的最大变革。然而，由于人们对该工艺影响人类健康的问题仍存疑虑，多个社区已禁止压裂作业。为评估压裂的潜在健康影响，我们分析了2004年至2013年宾夕法尼亚州逾110万例出生记录，比较了母亲居住在距离活跃压裂井场不同距离处的婴儿，以及在每个井场压裂作业开始前后出生的婴儿。我们通过比较子宫内是否暴露于压裂井场的同胞兄弟姐妹，调整了影响婴儿健康的固定母体因素。我们发现，子宫内暴露于母亲住所3公里范围内压裂井场的婴儿存在负面健康影响，其中子宫内暴露于1公里范围内的影响最大。负面健康影响包括低出生体重儿发生率上升，以及平均出生体重和其他多项婴儿健康指标的显著下降。在3公里以外的距离上，几乎没有健康影响的证据，表明压裂的健康影响具有高度局地性。非正式估算表明，美国每年近400万例出生中，约有2.9万例发生在活跃压裂井场1公里范围内，因此这些新生儿可能面临更高的不良出生结局风险。

title: New Evidence On The Impact of Sustained Exposure to Air Pollution on Life Expectancy From China’s Huai River Policy
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract:
This paper's findings suggest that an arbitrary Chinese policy that greatly increases total suspended particulates (TSPs) air pollution is causing the 500 million residents of Northern China to lose more than 2.5 billion life years of life expectancy. The quasi-experimental empirical approach is based on China’s Huai River policy, which provided free winter heating via the provision of coal for boilers in cities north of the Huai River but denied heat to the south. Using a regression discontinuity design based on distance from the Huai River, we find that ambient concentrations of TSPs are about 184 μg/m
3
[95% confidence interval (CI): 61, 307] or 55% higher in the north. Further, the results indicate that life expectancies are about 5.5 y (95% CI: 0.8, 10.2) lower in the north owing to an increased incidence of cardiorespiratory mortality. More generally, the analysis suggests that long-term exposure to an additional 100 μg/m
3
of TSPs is associated with a reduction in life expectancy at birth of about 3.0 y (95% CI: 0.4, 5.6).
abstract_zh: 本文的研究结果表明，中国一项任意的政策大幅增加了总悬浮颗粒物（TSPs）空气污染，使中国北方5亿居民的预期寿命损失超过25亿年。准实验实证方法以中国的淮河政策为基础，该政策向淮河以北的城市提供用于锅炉的煤炭并免费供应冬季取暖，而淮河以南则不提供供暖。利用基于与淮河距离的断点回归设计，我们发现北方的TSPs环境浓度约高出184 μg/m³（95%置信区间：61，307），即高出55%。此外，结果表明，由于心肺疾病死亡率上升，北方居民的出生时预期寿命约低5.5年（95%置信区间：0.8，10.2）。更一般地，分析表明，长期暴露于每增加100 μg/m³的TSPs，与出生时预期寿命减少约3.0年相关（95%置信区间：0.4，5.6）。
